findings.description: F002 says satisfaction matches evidence_class plus data_provenance, while F004 says availability=unavailable typed-skips must never satisfy a consumer-surface capture. Without an explicit shared rule, a degraded typed-skip carrying the required evidence_class could be counted as satisfied by the typing checker.
findings.recommendation: Specify that any EvidenceRef with availability=unavailable is excluded from F002 satisfaction and is only eligible for F004 honest-unavailability checks.

findings.description: F004 requires degraded EvidenceRefs to use an allowed degraded mode, but neither F001 nor F004 defines a structured field on EvidenceRef that carries the selected degraded mode. That leaves the checker unable to enforce allowed_degraded_modes without reading prose.
findings.recommendation: Add a structured degraded_mode field or define an existing structured field that carries the mode, then test that disallowed modes produce degraded_dishonest.

findings.description: F001 makes consumer_family optional even though F004 depends on per-family degradation and cross-family agreement. If availability-bearing EvidenceRefs omit consumer_family, the checker cannot reliably prove that each required family degraded honestly.
findings.recommendation: Require consumer_family on any EvidenceRef with data_source or availability, and require F003 agent adapters plus human degradation fixtures to populate it explicitly.

findings.description: The typing matrix is only partially pinned. F002 gives example requirements for several surfaces, but it does not explicitly define read_only requirements for every closed surface_class, including interactive_ui, mobile_app, external_integration, and service_batch.
findings.recommendation: Add a complete surface_class x claim_kind requirement table, including the default read_only group for every closed surface_class.

findings.description: The MCP adapter acceptance pins tools/list but leaves the second read-only tool as an example such as list_projects or status. That makes the dogfood fixture dependent on whatever tool happens to exist, weakening deterministic harness tests.
findings.recommendation: Pin the exact read-only MCP tool, expected request shape, expected response schema, and unavailable-source behavior if that tool is absent.

findings.description: The plan adds new agent EvidenceSource adapters, but F004 also requires human-family unavailable labels with structured data_source, availability, provenance, and consumer_family. The non-goal excludes rebuilding human-surface capture, yet no minimal compatibility path is specified.
findings.recommendation: Define the minimal human-side evidence path for degraded labels, such as fixture EvidenceRefs or a thin adapter-field upgrade, without expanding into full human-surface recapture.
